description: PostHog SURVEYS. Without surveyId: the project's surveys (name, type, running / complete / draft / archived, dates, questions); filter by status or search. With surveyId: that survey's questions (with their ids, for posthog_survey_responses) plus its stats: shown / dismissed / sent counts, response and dismissal rates, and per-question distributions and rating averages. NEEDS THE OPTIONAL survey:read SCOPE on the PostHog personal API key: a key without it connects fine and works for everything else, and this tool then says exactly which box to tick in PostHog > Settings > Personal API keys. That is never a reconnect. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs PostHog connected.

archived.description: PostHog archived filter: true or false; omit to leave it unfiltered

offset.description: skip this many surveys; use the nextOffset from the previous reply

search.description: match survey names containing this text

surveyId.description: one survey: its questions and stats

name: list_posthog_surveys
